articles.title: Proton beam therapy in the treatment of adenoid cystic carcinoma of the head and neck: a single enterprise retrospective cohort study
articles.summary: This retrospective study evaluates the clinical outcomes of curative-intent proton beam therapy for adenoid cystic carcinoma of the head and neck. Findings suggest favorable local control and manageable toxicity, though the authors emphasize the need for larger studies to compare definitive versus postoperative approaches.

articles.title: RadCalc 3D Monte-Carlo: tuning and independent dosimetric validation of radiotherapy treatment plans
articles.summary: This study details the implementation and validation of an independent Monte-Carlo based dose recalculation software for patient-specific quality assurance. The research provides a framework for integrating high-accuracy dose calculation verification into clinical linear accelerator workflows.

articles.title: A depth-resolved single-flask 3D clonogenic platform for continuous LET-dependent radiobiological assessment in carbon-ion therapy
articles.summary: This study introduces a novel 3D clonogenic assay platform designed to capture depth-dependent biological responses across carbon-ion beam paths. The platform facilitates high-density spatial sampling, supporting more accurate biophysical model validation compared to traditional point-wise assays.

articles.title: Reirradiation after repeat breast conserving treatment: Contemporary evidence, technical approaches, and expert recommendations
articles.summary: This review evaluates the role of repeat breast conserving therapy and reirradiation as an alternative to mastectomy for patients experiencing an ipsilateral breast tumor event. It synthesizes current evidence and technical considerations for clinicians managing recurrent disease in previously irradiated tissues.

articles.title: Risk stratification for immune-related pneumonitis in esophageal cancer: differential roles of systemic inflammation across severity grades and additive effect of radiation
articles.summary: Researchers investigated the relationship between baseline systemic inflammation, lung dose metrics (V20), and the risk of immune-related pneumonitis in esophageal cancer patients. The study suggests a framework for future risk stratification based on host-dosimetry interactions.

articles.title: Enhancing auto-segmentation accuracy and robustness through multiple deep learning systems
articles.summary: This research evaluates the use of multi-system fusion to improve the reliability of automated contouring in radiotherapy treatment planning. The proposed framework shows potential for generating higher-quality initial contours for clinical review.

articles.title: Beyond Pattern Recognition Artificial Intelligence for Integrated Diagnosis of Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma
articles.summary: This review discusses the diagnostic complexity of head and neck squamous cell carcinoma and the role of artificial intelligence in integrating multimodal evidence. It highlights how AI can improve diagnostic accuracy by synthesizing imaging, pathology, and molecular data.

articles.title: Predictors of radiation-induced lymphopenia in NSCLC: blood and bone marrow dose during chemoradiotherapy
articles.summary: This study analyzes the impact of radiation dose to circulating blood and bone marrow on the development of lymphopenia in patients with non-small cell lung cancer. Findings indicate that while dose to the blood is a predictor, radiation delivery optimization requires a multifactorial approach.

articles.title: Combination Strategies for Carbon Ion Radiotherapy: Biological Rationale, Clinical Evidence, and Future Directions
articles.summary: This review discusses the integration of carbon ion radiotherapy with other modalities to improve the therapeutic ratio. It outlines the current radiobiological understanding and clinical evidence supporting the use of high-LET radiation for radioresistant tumors.

articles.title: Cardio-immune crosstalk in novel radioimmunotherapy: implications for tumor immune remodeling, radiosensitization, and cardiac safety
articles.summary: The article examines the complex interactions between novel radiotherapy modalities—including proton therapy and FLASH—and the cardiac and immune systems. It highlights critical considerations for ensuring cardiac safety during advanced radioimmunotherapy regimens.

articles.title: Evaluating a large language model for radiotherapy patient scheduling under realistic clinical and operational constraints: A feasibility study
articles.summary: A feasibility study demonstrates the potential for large language models to assist in the complex process of radiotherapy patient scheduling. The research indicates that human-in-the-loop AI tools can effectively translate clinical priorities into actionable, feasible schedules.

articles.title: Assessment of simulated respiratory gating based on external-to-internal motion prediction using a hybrid, adaptive deep-learning network
articles.summary: Researchers developed a hybrid deep-learning network to improve respiratory gating accuracy during radiotherapy. The model successfully mitigates errors associated with breathing irregularities, showing significant potential for enhancing precision in motion-managed treatment delivery.

articles.title: CY 2027 Medicare Final Rules and Impact on Proton Therapy
articles.summary: The Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) finalized the CY 2027 Physician Fee Schedule and Hospital Outpatient Prospective Payment System rules, which include significant payment increases for proton therapy services in hospital outpatient settings due to budget neutrality redistributions. These changes take effect on January 1, 2027, and have prompted industry discussion regarding the long-term sustainability of accurate charge capture in these settings.

articles.title: BayCare Proton Center Treats First Patient on Mevion S250 FIT™ with Leo Cancer Care's Marie® Solution
articles.summary: The BayCare Proton Center has successfully initiated patient treatments using the Mevion S250 FIT proton therapy system integrated with Leo Cancer Care's Marie solution. This installation marks a new technological implementation in a clinical setting for advanced proton delivery.

articles.title: 50 million Americans live in counties without a radiation oncology clinic, study finds
articles.summary: A recent study highlights that 50 million Americans reside in counties lacking a radiation oncology clinic, underscoring significant geographic disparities in access to cancer care. The findings emphasize the ongoing challenges in providing equitable radiation treatment coverage across the United States.

articles.title: ASTRO updates guideline on shorter-course radiation therapy for localized prostate cancer
articles.summary: The American Society for Radiation Oncology (ASTRO) has released updated clinical guidelines regarding the use of shorter-course radiation therapy for patients with localized prostate cancer. These evidence-based updates aim to provide clinicians with standardized recommendations for treatment fractionation.

articles.title: IBA treats first patient in clinical trial of FLASH proton therapy for head and neck cancer
articles.summary: IBA has announced the treatment of the first patient in the C-FLASH-01 clinical trial, evaluating the safety and efficacy of ConformalFLASH proton therapy. This trial marks a significant milestone in testing ultra-high dose rate radiation delivery for head and neck cancer patients.

articles.title: Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute opens new wellness space
articles.summary: The Hampton University Proton Cancer Institute has inaugurated a new wellness facility dedicated to supporting patients and their caregivers. This regional development enhances the supportive care infrastructure at this key proton therapy center in the DMV area.
